description:
Chickpea, lentil or extra faba bean genes in a region (max 5 Mb) with descriptions, gene families, curated lentil
gene lists and best matches. dataset 'chickpea' (CDC Frontier v3, chromosomes chr1-chr8), 'chickpea_kabuli_v1'
(UWA kabuli v2.6.3, Ca1-Ca8), 'chickpea_desi' (UWA desi v3.0, Ca1-Ca8), 'lentil' (CDC Redberry v2, Chr1-Chr7),
'lentil_greenstar' (Lcu.1GRN.Chr1-7), 'lentil_ervoides' (Ler.1DRT.Chr1-7), 'faba_v2' (Hedin/2 v2, chr1_partA,
chr1_partB, chr2-chr6) or 'faba_tiffany' (chr1S, chr1L, chr2-chr6), or 'bean_v2' (common bean G19833 v2.1, Chr01-Chr11;
use this for positions from recent common bean papers; Ensembl/genes_in_region has v1). Chromosome numbers
alone (e.g. '4') are accepted.
name: legume_genes_in_region
